instruction: Let’s expand it the test that generated the 22 and see if we can find the patterns
scope: Add a separate frozen 40-question extension on the exact source bytes from the historical 22, with ten matched quote, direct, paraphrase and boundary groups.
Record native outcome, cited reference anchors, and bounded passage visibility for the focused question pairs.
validation: All 40 cases ran at the f9e71b9 engine state. The independent passage probe replay preserved all 40 native contracts.
The native reader fully supported 4/10 exact quote controls, 1/10 direct questions and 0/10 paraphrases. Nine quote controls cited their anchor. All 10 boundary controls withheld full support.
The passage probe surfaced all selected anchors for 7/10 direct and 7/10 paraphrased queries. Three focused test harness checks passed.
The focused source ZIP passed all 20 pattern and date tests, replayed all 40 cases, and reproduced the retained native answer-and-probe archive byte for byte.
limitations: The extension uses authored follow-up questions and selective source anchors. These results measure retrieval and native proof behavior under frozen conditions. Historical accuracy and independent semantic grading remain unmeasured.
The passage probe uses a separate entry point. Visibility there does not establish the strict reader's causal failure mechanism.
next_steps: Vary documentary date-role wording around the Fort Sumter case without weakening source attribution and scope checks. Test contingency, attribution and permission-plus-limit classes separately. Inspect Apollo 13 passage discovery before changing a causal proof rule.
